The Importance of Disaster Planning
When it comes to disaster planning for commercial
properties it’s not a matter of “if” disaster will
strike, it’s a matter of “when”. Not having a plan in
place could mean increased severity of damage,
higher costs, completion delays, business
interruption, secondary damage and unhappy
occupants or lost tenants.
Priority Response for Our Clients
In the event of an area-wide weather event or
disaster you will receive priority service as one of
our clients that is part of the Property Guardian
Program! By being part of the ERP you will receive
service is as little as half the time of non-priority
clients during such events!
